jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Equity is a big part of how we reward the people building ElevenLabs, and the programme is growing fast across many countries. You'll own the day-to-day running of it: keeping our cap table accurate and audit-ready, and making sure every grant, exercise and leaver is handled correctly and on time.

You'll work with Finance, Legal and People to turn board-approved decisions into clean records and clear communication. That includes issuing grants, supporting 409A and local valuations, and answering employee questions about their equity.

We're looking for someone who is meticulous about the numbers and who treats employees as customers. You'll find ways to automate the repetitive work, using AI wherever it makes things faster and more reliable.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience administering equity in a cap table or stock plan platform such as Carta, including grants, vesting, exercises, terminations, settlements and reconciliations.

  • Experience administering equity across multiple jurisdictions, including tracking globally mobile participants and coordinating with Tax and Payroll.

  • Strong understanding of stock options, RSUs, vesting schedules and employee lifecycle changes, with working knowledge of relevant tax-advantaged schemes such as US ISOs and UK EMI or CSOP plans.

  • Experience reconciling equity data with People, Talent, Payroll and Accounting records.

  • Understanding of stock-based compensation accounting sufficient to provide reliable data and support Finance with US GAAP and local reporting requirements.

  • Experience building and documenting equity processes and controls, managing deadlines independently and resolving discrepancies.

  • Clear communication skills, sound judgement when handling confidential information and a strong focus on employee support.

Bonus:

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, familiarity with 409A processes, or a record of automating equity workflows.

  • Certification (e.g. CEP or similar)

  • Experience with IPO process or having supported transition from private to public

Location:

This role is remote and can be executed between Central European and Eastern US timezones. If you prefer, you can work from one of our global offices.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Solution Design & Value Creation

  • Lead document message development in collaboration with client

  • Oncology, Infectious Disease, or Vaccine experience desired

  • Excellent conflict management and negotiation skills

jobs.title: Channel Account Executive - DACH
jobs.description:
Sales | Channel Management | Security | Software | German & English

Genetec - Protect the everyday

Wir sind ein weltweit tätiges kanadisches Unternehmen mit einem breit gefächerten Lösungsportfolio in den Bereichen Sicherheit, Intelligence und Operations. Unsere Kunden kommen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen, darunter Transport, Bildung und öffentliche Verwaltung. Bei Genetec fördern wir offene Kommunikation, Kreativität und kontinuierliches Lernen, damit jede und jeder die Möglichkeit hat, den eigenen, individuellen Karriereweg erfolgreich zu gestalten.

Unser globales Netzwerk von mehr als 2.300 Mitarbeitenden setzt sich aus vielfältigen Persönlichkeiten zusammen, die ihre Arbeit mit Leidenschaft ausüben und offen für neue Ideen sind. Der Erfolg und das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeitenden haben für uns höchste Priorität. Entdecken Sie das Arbeitsumfeld und die lebendige Unternehmenskultur von Genetec in diesem Video: - hier.

Ihre Aufgaben

Als Channel Account Executive (CAE) DACH sind Sie verantwortlich für den Ausbau, die Betreuung und das Wachstum des Genetec-Geschäfts mit bestehenden und neuen Vertriebspartnern in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Channel Sales Engineers, Account Executives, Marketing sowie weiteren internen Teams stärken Sie die Fähigkeiten unserer Partner, schaffen nachhaltiges Pipeline- und Umsatzwachstum und stellen eine konsistente Partnererfahrung sicher. Die Position berichtet direkt an den Area Sales Director DACH.

  • Ausbau des Channel-Geschäfts in der DACH-Region durch die Entwicklung gemeinsamer Geschäftspläne, Umsatzziele und gezielter Wachstumsinitiativen mit ausgewählten Partnern.
  • Betreuung, Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender strategischer Channel- und Lösungspartner sowie Identifikation und Gewinnung neuer Vertriebspartner in der DACH-Region mit besonderem Fokus auf Deutschland.
  • Aufbau und Pflege einer belastbaren, partnergenerierten Vertriebspipeline; Erstellung von Umsatzprognosen sowie regelmäßiges Reporting zu Strategie, Fortschritten, Risiken und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen an das Management.
  • Weiterleitung und Nachverfolgung von Leads gemeinsam mit Partnern, Sicherstellung der Erfassung und Pflege von Opportunities im CRM-System sowie Überwachung von Projekten, die nicht als High-Touch-Deals durch die Account-Executive-Organisation geführt werden.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Account Executives und Channel Sales Engineers bei der Betreuung von Kundenkonten, der Entwicklung von Vertriebsstrategien, der Auswahl geeigneter Partner und der erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten.
  • Koordination der Kommunikation zwischen Vertriebspartnern, Genetec-Abteilungen, Beratern und Technologiepartnern, um einen konsistenten und skalierbaren Go-to-Market-Ansatz sicherzustellen.
  • Planung und Durchführung von Partner-Reviews, Vertriebsenablement-Maßnahmen, Veranstaltungen und gezielten Marketinginitiativen; Koordination technischer Schulungen sowie Überwachung von Trainingserfolg und Partnerzufriedenheit.

Ihr Profil

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten, auch wenn nicht jede einzelne Anforderung vollständig erfüllt wird. Wenn Sie von dieser Rolle begeistert sind und überzeugt sind, einen Mehrwert leisten zu können, möchten wir Sie gerne kennenlernen.

  • Mindestens 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb und/oder Business Development im Bereich physische Sicherheit, Technologievertrieb oder Lösungsvertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in einer relevanten Channel- oder Business-Development-Funktion.
  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau neuer Channel-Partnerschaften sowie in der Geschäftsentwicklung mit Systemintegratoren und anderen Lösungspartnern.
  • Fundiertes Verständnis des Marktes für physische Sicherheit, einschließlich Videomanagement-Software, Zutrittskontrollsystemen und der dazugehörigen IT-Infrastruktur.
  • Kenntnisse von VSaaS- (Video Surveillance as a Service) und Cloud-Strategien sowie von direkten Hersteller-zu-Partner-Vertriebsmodellen.
  • Erfahrung in der gemeinsamen Geschäftsplanung mit Partnern, im Opportunity-Management, Forecasting sowie im professionellen Umgang mit CRM-Systemen.
  • Fähigkeit, den Mehrwert der Genetec-Lösungen überzeugend zu vermitteln und Produkt-, Markt- sowie Wettbewerbswissen in konkreten Geschäftsnutzen für Partner zu übersetzen.
  • Ausgeprägte Präsentations-, Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise.
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse; zusätzliche Kenntnisse der DACH-Märkte sind von Vorteil.
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der DACH-Region von mindestens 50 % der Arbeitszeit.
  • Proaktive und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit unternehmerischem Denken, Ergebnisorientierung und Freude an Herausforderungen.
  • Positive Ausstrahlung und hohe Energie, die zur Förderung von Teamarbeit, Engagement und einer starken Teamkultur beiträgt.
  • Freude an der Arbeit in einem vielfältigen und internationalen Team.

Das bieten wir Ihnen

  • Die Möglichkeit, in einem internationalen und kooperativen Umfeld einen echten Beitrag zu leisten.
  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Kreativität, frische Ideen und das Hinterfragen des Status quo fördert.
  • Die Chance, Teil eines weltweit führenden Unternehmens mit einer offenen und unterstützenden Arbeitsatmosphäre zu werden.
  • Zugang zu zahlreichen Vergünstigungen über unser Corporate-Discount-Programm.
  • Kostenlose Französischkurse zur Förderung der internationalen Zusammenarbeit.
  • Teilnahme an internationalen Teamevents und Konferenzen sowie Aufbau wertvoller länderübergreifender Netzwerke.
  • Attraktives Provisionsmodell zur Anerkennung Ihres Beitrags zum Unternehmenserfolg.
  • Kfz-Zuschuss zur Unterstützung Ihrer Reisetätigkeit innerhalb der Region.
  • 30 Urlaubstage für eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance.
  • Zuschuss zu Fitness- und Gesundheitsangeboten zur Förderung Ihres Wohlbefindens.

Genetec ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir diskriminieren niemanden aufgrund von ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Hautfarbe, Religion, Alter, Nationalität, Familienstand, Behinderung, Veteranenstatus, genetischer Informationen, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität oder eines anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmals.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are a global Canadian company with a broad solutions portfolio that encompasses security, intelligence, and operations. We serve customers within a wide range of industries including transportation, education, and government. At Genetec we embrace open communication, creativity, and continuous learning to allow everyone to flourish in their own unique career paths.

Our network of over 2300 people globally is made up of diverse individuals who are passionate about their work and open to trying new ideas. We prioritize the success and well-being of our employees. Discover Genetec's work environment and lively culture in this video - here.

What your day will look like

As Channel Account Executive (CAE) DACH, you will be responsible for developing, managing and growing Genetec business with existing and new channel partners across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Working closely with Channel Sales Engineers, Account Executives, Marketing and other internal teams, you will strengthen partner capability, create sustainable pipeline and revenue growth, and ensure a consistent partner experience. The role reports directly to the Area Sales Director DACH.

  • Grow channel sales across the DACH territory by developing joint business plans, revenue objectives and targeted growth initiatives with selected partners.
  • Manage, support and further develop existing strategic Channel and solution partners, while identifying and onboarding new channel relationships across the DACH region. Strong Focus on Germany
  • Build and maintain a reliable partner-generated pipeline; develop channel revenue forecasts and regularly report strategy, progress, risks and competitive developments to management.
  • Distribute and follow up leads with partners, ensure opportunities are captured and updated in CRM, and track projects that are not managed as High-Touch deals by the Account Executive organisation.
  • Work closely with Account Executives and Channel Sales Engineers on account coverage, opportunity strategy, partner selection and the successful delivery of customer projects.
  • Coordinate communication between channel partners, Genetec departments, consultants and technology partners to create a consistent and scalable go-to-market approach.
  • Plan and deliver partner business reviews, sales enablement, events and targeted marketing initiatives; coordinate technical training and monitor training effectiveness and partner satisfaction.

 

About you

We welcome all qualified candidates, including those who may not meet every listed requirement. If you're excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

  • At least 7 years of experience in sales and/or business development within physical security, technology or solution sales, including at least 3 years in a relevant channel or business development role.
  • Proven ability to develop new channel relationships and grow business with system integrators and other solution partners.
  • Strong understanding of the physical security market, including video management software, access control systems and related IT infrastructure.
  • Understanding of VSaaS and cloud solution strategies as well as direct manufacturer-to-partner channel models.
  • Experience with partner business planning, opportunity management, revenue forecasting and CRM discipline.
  • Ability to understand and articulate the Genetec value proposition and to translate product, market and competitive knowledge into partner-facing business value.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, combined with a structured, self-driven and collaborative working style.
  • Native-level German and business-fluent English; additional DACH market knowledge is a strong advantage.
  • Willingness to travel within the DACH region for a minimum of 50% of working time.
  • You proactively manage your responsibilities, embrace challenges, and drive meaningful outcomes through an entrepreneurial and results-oriented approach.
  • A positive attitude and high energy, helping to drive teamwork, engagement, and a strong team culture.
  • Exited to work in a diverse Team

 

What’s in it for you

  • Make a meaningful impact in an international and collaborative environment.
  • Be part of a culture that values creativity, fresh ideas, and challenging the status quo.
  • Join an industry-leading global company with a supportive and open atmosphere.
  • Access a wide range of partner perks through our Corporate Discount Program.
  • Enhance your international collaboration with French language classes.
  • Participate in international team events and conferences, building strong cross-regional connections.
  • Benefit from an Employee Commission Plan that recognizes your contribution to business success.
  • Receive a car allowance to support travel across the region.
  • Enjoy 30 days of vacation to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • Take advantage of our Fitness Club contribution to support your well-being.

 

Genetec is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Business Analyst (Safeguarding, Treasury & Accounting)
jobs.description:
Role: Senior Finance Business Analyst (Safeguarding, Treasury & Accounting)

Start Date: ASAP

Employment Type: Fixed Term Contract – 3 Months
Location: Hybrid (London)

Programme: FCA Cryptoasset Regulatory Regime / CASS 17 Implementation

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance Business Analyst to support a high-profile regulatory programme focused on the implementation of the FCA Cryptoasset Regime. Working across Finance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Compliance, Risk and Technology, you will play a key role in translating regulatory requirements into practical operating models, controls, processes and technology solutions.

This role will focus on the design and implementation of frameworks required under CASS 17, including cryptoasset safeguarding, reconciliation, record keeping, governance and financial control processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Gather, analyse and document business, regulatory and operational requirements relating to the FCA Cryptoasset Regime.

  2. Translate CASS 17 safeguarding requirements into detailed business processes, controls and operating procedures.

  3. Conduct current-state and target-state assessments across Finance, Treasury and Accounting functions.

  4. Define reconciliation, record-keeping and client asset safeguarding requirements for cryptoasset activities.

  5. Support impact assessments across people, process, data, controls and technology.

  6. Facilitate workshops with senior stakeholders across Finance, Treasury, Operations, Compliance, Product and Technology.

  7. Produce business requirements, process maps, user stories and functional specifications.

  8. Partner with SMEs to design governance, oversight and control frameworks.

  9. Identify regulatory, operational and financial risks and support remediation planning.

  10. Ensure alignment between regulatory obligations, operating model design and technology delivery.

  11. Support programme governance, reporting and stakeholder communications.


Required Experience

  1. Extensive experience as a Business Analyst within Financial Services.

  2. Strong understanding of Finance, Treasury and Accounting processes.

  3. Proven experience delivering regulatory change programmes.

  4. Experience gathering requirements and producing high-quality BA artefacts.

  5. Ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders across multiple functions.

  6. Strong process mapping, gap analysis and operating model design experience.

  7. Experience working on complex cross-functional transformation programmes.

Desirable Experience

  1. Knowledge of FCA regulations and regulatory change delivery.

  2. Experience working within Client Assets (CASS), Safeguarding or Asset Protection frameworks.

  3. Exposure to cryptoassets, digital assets, custody or exchange businesses.

  4. Treasury controls, reconciliations, ledger accounting and financial reporting experience.

  5. Experience supporting FCA authorisation, regulatory applications or compliance programmes.

  6. Knowledge of governance, risk and control frameworks.

Ideal Background

Candidates are likely to come from organisations such as banks, fintechs, payment firms, crypto platforms, custodians, wealth managers or regulatory consulting environments where they have delivered regulatory change initiatives impacting Finance, Treasury, Client Assets, Safeguarding or Risk functions.

How We Work:  

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire.  

This is a FTC/Contract position located in London with hybrid working. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. For this role, a valid working permit for the UK is mandatory.  

Expectations regarding hybrid working: As we are a Service Provider and Consulting firm servicing clients, our policy for physically working from the office (which may be the clients' offices or our own offices depending on the client) aligns to what our clients' policies and expectations are and these vary. Most of our clients now require a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, 2 days from home, and accordingly this is also the minimum expectation that Delta Capita require.

  • Take autonomy capability from integration and test into fielded operation, and close the loop from test data back into the stack.

  • Mentor and technically guide a growing team of robotics engineers.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, and set the standard for what good looks like.

  • Travel up to 25% of the time for onsite test and integration events.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

  • 3+ years building soft-real-time embedded systems.

  • Deep expertise in at least one systems language (Golang, Rust, or C/C++).

  • Proven experience deploying and validating robotics algorithms (Dubins planning, SLAM, Kalman filters, particle filters, A*, behavior trees, reinforcement learning, etc.).

  • Working knowledge of embedded systems (SPI/I2C/serial protocols, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, microcontroller programming).

  • Strong networking fundamentals (NAT, mDNS, UDP/TCP, multicast, firewall configuration).

  • Experience with robotics middleware (DDS/ROS2, ZeroMQ, gRPC) and serialization formats (Protobuf).

  • Familiarity with government UxS interoperability standards (OMS/UCI, STANAG 4586, FACE).

jobs.title: Service Monteur Warmtepompen
jobs.description:
De meeste monteurs in Nederland vervangen vandaag nog steeds ketels die er over tien jaar niet meer staan.

Ben je loodgieter, servicemonteur of cv-monteur? Bij ons stap je over op de techniek die daarvoor in de plaats komt. Ervaring met warmtepompen hoeft niet, die leren we je. Wat je wel meeneemt is je gevoel voor leidingwerk. Geen storingsdienst, een volledig uitgeruste bus, en je werkdag begint als je instapt.

WIJ MAKEN WARMTE ZONDER GAS

Wist je dat wij onze warmtepompen zelf ontwerpen? Met een club van rond de zestig mensen bedenken we ze, assembleren we ze in Utrecht en installeren we ze zelf. Voor huiseigenaren door heel Nederland en sinds dit jaar ook in Duitsland. Vorig jaar won onze Pomp MP als eerste warmtepomp ooit zowel de iF Design Award Gold als de Red Dot.

Elke week gaan er tientallen huizen van het gas af. Het doel is 10% van alle Nederlandse woningen, ongeveer 800.000 huizen. De vraag is er en het product staat. De rem zit op hoe snel we kunnen leveren.

Dat lukt niet zonder jou als servicemonteur.

WAT JIJ HIER DOET

  • Onderhoud aan onze warmtepompen

  • Storingen oplossen die het serviceteam niet op afstand kon verhelpen

  • Installaties inspecteren en optimaliseren

  • Klanten uitleggen wat er aan de hand is, in gewone taal

  • Terugkoppelen wat je in het veld ziet, zodat het product beter wordt

Ongeveer de helft van de storingen zit in onze eigen warmtepomp, waterzijdig of elektrisch. De andere helft zit in de woninginstallatie. Een radiator die niet warm wordt hebben wij niet geplaatst, maar we sturen de klant niet weg. Dat lossen we ook op.

WAAROM MONTEURS BIJ ONS BLIJVEN

Geen storingsdienst. Geen consignatie. Reistijd is werktijd. En jij kiest zelf tussen dertien ADV-dagen of meer salaris per maand.

Ons serviceteam op kantoor lost ongeveer negen van de tien meldingen op afstand op en plant jouw week in. Jij rijdt naar de klanten waar echt iemand langs moet. Je krijgt geen telefoon om acht uur ’s avonds.

Loop je bij een klant vast, dan bellen onze specialisten in en kijken ze met je mee. Die zitten bij ons in dienst, dus je hebt ze binnen een minuut aan de lijn. Geen half uur in de wacht bij een ketelmerk dat er geen belang bij heeft dat jouw storing vandaag opgelost wordt. Wij hebben hetzelfde doel als jij, dus die stap slaan we over.

Zit iemand in het weekend zonder warm water, dan schakelen wij een cv-monteur in en betalen dat zelf. Onze warmtepompboiler heeft bovendien een elektrisch element, dus niemand staat koud.

Je werkt zelfstandig vanuit je bus, maar je zit in een serviceteam en hebt korte lijnen met het magazijn en met productontwikkeling.

WAT DIT JE OPLEVERT

Over twee jaar ken jij deze systemen beter dan bijna iedereen in dit land, simpelweg omdat er nog maar weinig mensen zijn die er dagelijks aan werken. Dat is een positie die je zelf in handen hebt, en die alleen maar meer waard wordt.

Daar komt bij: omdat wij het product zelf maken, gaat wat jij in het veld ziet rechtstreeks naar de engineers. Je lost niet alleen storingen op, je zorgt dat ze de volgende keer niet meer voorkomen.

WAT JE MEEBRENGT

  • Een paar jaar ervaring als loodgieter, servicemonteur, storingsmonteur, installatiemonteur W, cv-monteur of monteur werktuigbouwkundige installaties

  • Of een technische mbo-opleiding met de praktijkervaring die daarbij hoort. Starters zoeken we niet

  • Ervaring met leidingwerk. Dat is het enige wat we niet in een paar maanden kunnen bijbrengen. De elektra kant en onze eigen warmtepompen leren we je wel

  • Rijbewijs B

  • Nederlands of Engels waarmee je een klant kunt uitleggen wat er aan de hand is

  • Zin om een nieuwe techniek onder de knie te krijgen

Bij de klant ben jij DeWarmte. Iemand moet blij zijn dat jij binnenkomt en het gevoel hebben: die gaat het voor mij oplossen. En omdat we hard groeien, is de situatie op locatie niet altijd zoals hij op je werkbon staat. Soms wil de klant er nog iets bij, soms is de voorbereiding niet compleet. Dan zoek jij een oplossing in plaats van een schuldige.

Twijfel je of je past? Bel of app Marvin even op 06 1111 9775.

We zoeken nu versterking in de driehoek Zwolle, Apeldoorn en Deventer. Woon je daar in de buurt, dan zetten we een voorraadpunt bij jou in de regio neer zodat je niet steeds naar Utrecht hoeft.

WAT JE KRIJGT

– € 3.000 tot € 5.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je ervaring

– Een werkweek van 38 uur, of 40 uur met dertien ADV-dagen. Jij kiest

– Parttime kan ook, vanaf 24 uur per week

– 25 vakantiedagen bij fulltime, plus 8% vakantiegeld dat we maandelijks uitbetalen

– Een volledig uitgeruste bedrijfsbus, laptop en telefoon

– Reistijd is werktijd, vanaf het moment dat je instapt

– Opleidingen en trainingen tot je specialist bent in warmtepompen

– Deelname aan ons SAR-programma en mee op de jaarlijkse winterreis

MET WIE JE WERKT

Je komt in het serviceteam van Lars Steverink, Head of Service. Hij startte vijf jaar geleden bij DeWarmte toen het bedrijf uit vier mensen bestond en bouwde de serviceorganisatie op. Je werkt dagelijks samen met de servicecoördinatie in Den Haag die je route plant, met het magazijn in Utrecht en met de engineers die de warmtepompen ontwerpen.

HOE HET GAAT

We nemen op dit moment ongeveer vier mensen per maand aan, en de teams die we nu bouwen moeten staan voor de piek aan het eind van het jaar. Reageer je deze week, dan zit je er nog bij.

  1. Bel of app Marvin op 06 1111 9775, of stuur je cv. Een motivatiebrief hoeft niet.

  2. Kennismaking van een half uur. Daarna kom je langs, ook in Utrecht waar de warmtepompen in elkaar worden gezet en getest.

  3. Binnen vijf werkdagen weet je waar je staat.

Compensation: €3K – €5K per month

  • • €3K – €5K per month

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Kairos has historically made a small number of large, ongoing bets, like SPAR and Pathfinder. Running Generator taught us that this left a lot of value on the table. As our ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops), you will build the AI capabilities at the core of ARAIAS: evaluating and fine-tuning computer vision models on smart glasses data, running the ML operations behind them, and applying generative AI to create synthetic medical images for education. We're at an early stage — moving from concept to working prototype — so the near-term focus is on validating models and building toward a proof of concept we can test in real education and clinical settings.

As part of a small team, you will own the full data lifecycle end to end — from sourcing, consent and annotation to preparation — alongside model development and deployment.

We welcome candidates at different experience levels. What matters most is a solid ML foundation and genuine awareness of the medical imaging domain.

  • Research and assess state-of-the-art ML models and emerging trends, including Explainable AI (XAI), cybersecurity for ML, and deployment and distribution modes (edge vs. cloud, federated learning, model compression)

  • Plan and execute the ML operations pipeline — data gathering, annotation, preparation, training, testing and deployment

  • Propose a data collection strategy — research suitable public and clinical data sources, recommend patient consent and other administrative requirements for ML training (e.g., data protection agreements, ethics approval), and define collection and annotation protocols with clinical experts, including labeling guidelines and quality checks

  • Identify and validate factors that affect model performance — image conditions, dataset bias, patient diversity, data privacy and regulatory requirements

  • Define test strategies and metrics, and validate model outputs against clinician assessments

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions appropriate for the current prototyping stage and document results clearly

jobs.title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Detection Engineer
jobs.description:
Artemis is building the future of AI-driven cybersecurity, helping companies defend themselves effectively in an era where AI is fighting AI on the cyber battlefield.

Our platform brings a new approach to the $100B security operations market, building a live model of each customer's environment and using AI agents to detect, investigate, hunt, and respond to threats at machine speed. Just one year after our founding, Artemis is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies of all time, with customers including multiple Fortune 500 companies, Global 2000 enterprises, and AI innovators like Cursor.

We have raised $70M from Felicis, First Round Capital, Theory Ventures, Two Sigma Ventures, Lockstep VC and Brightmind. We are also backed by some of the most prominent operators in cybersecurity, including the CEO of Crowdstrike, the former CEO and CTO of Splunk, and the founders of Abnormal AI and Demisto.

Artemis's founders have built and scaled security products used by tens of thousands of customers. Shachar Hirshberg (CEO) led Amazon GuardDuty, the world's largest cloud detection product, was an early employee at Demisto, the company that invented the SOAR category, was an engineering leader at Palo Alto Networks, and holds an MBA from Harvard. Dan Shiebler (CTO) led all AI and machine learning at Abnormal AI, the pioneer of behavior-based detection, spent five years building analytics using machine learning and vector databases at Twitter, and holds a PhD in machine learning from Oxford.

Our team of software engineers, AI researchers, security engineers, and product designers comes from Google, Meta, AWS, Wiz, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Abnormal AI, Perplexity, Bridgewater, Mercor, CERN, and more.

We're growing fast and looking for builders who want to help us serve our rapidly expanding customer base.

About the Role

We're looking for a Detection Engineer to own the detection content that powers the Artemis platform. You'll design, build, test, and continuously tune high-fidelity detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments — treating detection as code, and using AI as a force multiplier at every step: authoring rules with AI assistance, and building anomaly detections that learn what's normal in each environment and flag what isn't. Detections at Artemis don't just fire alerts; they feed an AI-native investigation pipeline, so precision, rich context, and machine-readable output matter as much as coverage. This is a hands-on engineering role where every rule you ship directly determines what threats we catch for customers and how fast we catch them.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain the detection library - Design, implement, and own high-fidelity detections across cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity (Okta, Entra ID), endpoint (EDR), and SaaS log sources, from hypothesis to production.

  • Practice detection-as-code - Manage detection content like software: version-controlled rules, peer review, automated validation and testing, and CI/CD deployment across customer environments.

  • Map and close coverage gaps - Measure detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, prioritize gaps based on real-world threat activity, and systematically close them.

  • Validate against real attacks - Build and run attack simulations and test harnesses to prove detections fire on true positives and stay quiet on benign activity, before and after they ship.

  • Tune relentlessly - Own false-positive and false-negative rates across the fleet: analyze detection performance data, tune noisy logic at the source, and sunset detections that no longer earn their keep.

  • Use AI to write detections at scale - Leverage AI throughout the detection lifecycle: use AI-assisted workflows to author, convert, test, and document rules faster than any traditional team could, and build the tooling that makes AI-generated detection content trustworthy enough to ship.

  • Build behavioral and anomaly-based detections - Go beyond static signatures: establish behavioral baselines of normal activity per environment (identity, cloud, SaaS usage patterns) and engineer anomaly detections that surface deviations — impossible travel, unusual privilege use, novel API activity — with high signal and low noise.

  • Engineer detections for AI-powered investigation - Design detections that produce rich, structured context so the Artemis platform can investigate and resolve cases autonomously.

  • Turn intelligence into detections - Translate threat intelligence, incident findings, and threat hunt results from our research and SOC teams into durable, behavioral detection logic.

  • Partner with the SOC and research teams - Close the loop with Apollo analysts and security researchers: use case outcomes and analyst feedback to drive detection improvements, and give them documentation that makes every alert investigable.

  • Support customer-specific tuning - Adapt and tune detection content to each customer's environment and business context, reducing noise without sacrificing coverage.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience, with significant time in detection engineering

  • Proven track record designing, building, and tuning detections at scale across SIEM, EDR, or custom detection platforms

  • Strong proficiency in detection languages and formats such as Sigma, KQL, SPL, or YARA-L, and comfort writing code (Python preferred) for automation and testing

  • Deep knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (MITRE ATT&CK) and how they manifest in logs across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS telemetry

  • Experience with detection-as-code workflows: Git, peer review, automated testing, and CI/CD for detection content

  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate detection authoring, tuning, or validation — and judgment about when AI-generated logic is ready to ship

  • Experience building behavioral or anomaly-based detections: establishing baselines of normal activity and engineering detections that flag meaningful deviations

  • Strong log-analysis skills and demonstrated ability to distinguish malicious activity from benign noise across diverse data sources

  • Clear written and verbal communication — able to document detection logic and explain coverage and trade-offs to engineers, analysts, and customers

Bonus

  • Experience in an MDR, MSSP, or high-volume SOC environment

  • Experience with attack simulation and validation frameworks (Atomic Red Team, purple teaming)

  • Background in threat hunting or incident response across cloud environments

  • Experience with UEBA platforms or statistical/ML-based detection methods (peer grouping, time-series baselining, outlier scoring)

  • Experience building AI-assisted detection or investigation tooling from scratch

  • Contributions to open-source detection content or the broader detection engineering community

Why Work at Artemis?

  • Make a real world impact. You'll lead the human layer of defense that protects real companies. Every standard you set and process you sharpen raises the quality of protection customers depend on.

  • Be challenged to be better than ever before. Our team includes some of the smartest and most driven people in the world. We guarantee you will learn more in 1 year here than 10 years in another place.

  • Push the boundaries of technology. Lead a SOC built on the most advanced AI capabilities in cybersecurity, where the platform automates detection, investigation, and tuning, and your team owns the expertise, response, and relationship. You'll define what a modern, AI-native MDR looks like.

  • Innovative culture. We obsess about customers, move fast with high quality, and value open communication, mentorship and learning. You'll have the autonomy to shape the direction of the operation and own outcomes, not just run a runbook.

If you are passionate about cyber security and want to build and lead the team at the cutting edge of AI-powered defense, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation of $160,000-190,000 per year, and a top-of-market equity component. A variety of factors are considered when determining the compensation, including a candidate's professional experience. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed.

Equal Opportunity

At Artemis, we believe the best ideas come from diverse teams. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can do their best work. We welcome everyone, regardless of race, gender, age, religion, identity, or anything else that makes you, you.

  • ISVs. The vendors that shape and route security data (Cribl and its peers) as well as domain specific security companies helps us secure customers together. Build the reference architectures and joint plays that helps customers stay safe.

Many of these relationships are already in motion at the executive level. Your job is to take them from conversations to signed, integrated, revenue-producing partnerships, and to decide what we pursue next.

We're not collecting logos. A partnership counts when it produces something measurable: sourced pipeline, marketplace revenue, an integration customers actually turn on, a partner seller who pulls us into a deal.   • Alliance-sourced and alliance-influenced pipeline is a tracked, growing number the whole company can see

jobs.description:
Artemis is building the future of AI-driven cybersecurity, helping companies defend themselves effectively in an era where AI is fighting AI on the cyber battlefield.

Our platform brings a new approach to the $100B security operations market, building a live model of each customer's environment and using AI agents to detect, investigate, hunt, and respond to threats at machine speed. Just one year after our founding, Artemis is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies of all time, with customers including multiple Fortune 500 companies, Global 2000 enterprises, and AI innovators like Cursor.

We have raised $70M from Felicis, First Round Capital, Theory Ventures, Two Sigma Ventures, Lockstep VC and Brightmind. We are also backed by some of the most prominent operators in cybersecurity, including the CEO of Crowdstrike, the former CEO and CTO of Splunk, and the founders of Abnormal AI and Demisto.

Artemis's founders have built and scaled security products used by tens of thousands of customers. Shachar Hirshberg (CEO) led Amazon GuardDuty, the world's largest cloud detection product, was an early employee at Demisto, the company that invented the SOAR category, was an engineering leader at Palo Alto Networks, and holds an MBA from Harvard. Dan Shiebler (CTO) led all AI and machine learning at Abnormal AI, the pioneer of behavior-based detection, spent five years building analytics using machine learning and vector databases at Twitter, and holds a PhD in machine learning from Oxford.

Our team of software engineers, AI researchers, security engineers, and product designers comes from Google, Meta, AWS, Wiz, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Abnormal AI, Perplexity, Bridgewater, Mercor, CERN, and more.

We're growing fast and looking for builders who want to help us serve our rapidly expanding customer base.

You'll build our pipeline, develop strategic relationships with security executives, and close deals that prove our value in market. Qualifications

You've sold into Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 security organizations with deal sizes of $250K-$1M+ and know how to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise security architectures and the CISO buying journey. You speak fluently about detection, response, AI/ML in security, and can hold your own in technical conversations about data platforms, SIEM, EDR/XDR, and cloud security.

  • Established relationships with enterprise CISOs, security leaders, and security operations teams. You have credibility in the market and know how to leverage it.

  • Track record of building pipeline without heavy marketing support. You're a hunter who thrives on ecosystem leverage and creating your own opportunities.

Why Work at Artemis?

Make a real world impact. Help empower cybersecurity teams around the world to keep people safe from the most advanced AI-powered cyber threats.

Be challenged to be better than ever before. Our team includes some of the smartest and most driven people in the world. We guarantee you will learn more in 1 year here than 10 years anywhere else.

Build the foundation. You're not joining an established sales machine - you're building it. Your success creates the blueprint. Your deals prove the category. Your feedback shapes the product.

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

  • Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
  • Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
  • Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
  • Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
  • Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
  • Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.

What Success Looks Like:

  • You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
  • Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
  • Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
  • Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
  • You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
  • You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
  • Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
  • Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
  • Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
  • Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
  • Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
  • Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
  • Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

jobs.title: Senior Producer
jobs.description:
Senior Producer

ScapeWorld Entertainment

Remote. Our working day runs on CET, wherever you sit. Full time, on a long-term contract. Starting as soon as you can. Where you live while you do is up to you; the location field on this posting only fits one country, so please read this as the real rule and apply from wherever you are.

About us

We are Scape, a Swedish game studio of about 30 people, fully remote by choice. We are launching Scape on Steam Early Access later this year: a growing platform of multiplayer games where a player's identity carries across all of them. The first game inside Scape is Gravity: a precision climbing game where 100 players share one server, one tower, and one long way down. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios, Epic and Ubisoft.

Since we are a small team about to put our first game in front of players, we are looking for the person who holds the plan, the priorities and the team together while we do it. If that sounds like you, we would love to meet.

The role

Let us start with the studio you would be joining. Around thirty people, fully remote, and a group of strong leads in design, art, engineering, QA, community and commercial who own their crafts and run their own teams. What we do not have is the person who looks across all of them at once, holds the plan they are all working to, and makes the day-to-day calls that keep it moving as one. That is this role. It is the only production seat in the company, and it comes with real authority.

You would work closely with the Creative Director. They own what the game is, set the direction and make the big bets. You own the plan that gets us there and the decisions inside it: scope, sequencing and trade-offs within a milestone are yours to make, and you decide which questions need to reach them and which do not. They should be able to step back and know that things are being handled, because they are.

In practice, it comes down to four things:

You know how a game gets made. You can see what depends on what, where the effort really sits, and whether an estimate is going to hold. When a lead tells you how long something takes, you know how to hear it and what has to land for the work to ship on time.

You own the plan and the priorities. Not just the schedule, but the order of work behind it. When two things compete, you decide, or you get the decision made and tell everyone affected. Open questions have an owner and a date. Nothing sits unanswered because nobody was sure whose call it was.

You plan ahead. Problems get found while they are still cheap, and everything that has to land together lands together: builds, assets, store material, localization, press dates.

You lead the team's delivery. People know the plan is real, feel good about hitting it, and are still standing when it ships. The leads lead their crafts. You lead how it all comes together, and you meet each team where it is: some want you in the weeds with them on estimates and sequencing, others mainly need the picture across teams kept current. You read which is which.

We have a production pipeline that works, and like any pipeline it can always be better. You would inherit it as it is, get to know it and the people who run it, and then improve it where you see the need. Nobody here expects you to arrive with all the answers. We do hope you arrive curious about how we work and comfortable telling us, kindly and clearly, where we could do better.


What you will own

  • Production priorities day to day: the order of work across the studio, the trade-off calls within a milestone, and every open question that is blocking someone. You find who can answer, get it answered or escalated with a clear recommendation attached, and close the loop with the teams waiting on it. If a question is blocking someone, it is yours until it is not

  • Keeping design, art, engineering, QA and marketing in step with each other, week by week, so nobody is working against a version of the plan that has moved

  • The forward view: every feature in flight, what each one is still waiting on, the handoffs between departments caught early, and risk seen while it is still cheap, named, and carrying a mitigation before it turns into a schedule event

  • The team's delivery health: sustainable pace, morale, and delivery on target, treated as one problem rather than a trade-off

  • Marketing as a real production dependency, and the alignment dates around release: builds, assets, store material, localization drops, press dates, landing on time and together

  • The production plan behind all of it: a milestone schedule with a baseline, a forecast per milestone from velocity against remaining scope, estimates held against actuals, and replanning on a cycle rather than after something breaks

  • QA in step with everyone else. Our QA lead owns testing; you make sure QA knows what is coming and when, that testable builds land when the plan says they do, and that the QA window sits in the schedule where it belongs rather than where it ends up

  • External production partners: localization, video, 3D, anything we outsource. You own the relationship and the communication in both directions, and you chase. Briefs and context going out, deliveries coming in and landing in the build, and the schedule that keeps them in step with everyone else. Leads should never have to chase a partner themselves. The craft stays with the partner; making it fit is on you

  • The production process itself and the tools it runs through. We use Jira, including Jira Plans for planning months out against a baseline, and you own it for the studio. You also support hiring managers through their recruitment processes, so a lead who is hiring can focus on assessing the person rather than running the process


You

Most people who can do this job have around five years in games production behind them. Take that as a description of who tends to apply, not a bar we hold. If you can show us the things below with less, please apply anyway. We would rather meet you than miss you.

  • You know how games get made across disciplines: what waits on what, how long things really take, and where a plan is optimistic before the dates say so

  • You have produced across several titles and taken at least one PC title all the way to release, including the closing stretch: feature lock, bug burn, submission, the go decision. Which store matters less than that you have been through a PC launch. Projects that were cancelled along the way still count; we know how the last few years have gone for a lot of good people

  • You have owned priorities, not just a schedule. You have made cut-or-keep calls on a shipped title and lived with them, and you can tell us about one you got wrong

  • You have worked closely with a founder, studio head or creative director, and you know how to take decisions off their plate without going around them

  • You have built and driven a schedule, and you have written down a way of working that other people picked up and used. We would love to see examples, in whatever form they exist

  • You have led a team to a target without burning it out, and the people on it would work with you again

  • You are proactive by default and you work independently. You do not wait to be asked or chased; given an assignment, you find out what it needs and finish it well without someone checking each step. That is what senior means to us

  • Leads tell you how things are really going, because you talk with them directly and they trust you with the real picture

  • You are fluent in Jira at the level of owning it for a team, Jira Plans included. It is a tool, not the job, but it is the tool we run the plan through, so we need you good with it

  • You work our day, which runs on CET; where you sit while you do is up to you. And you are comfortable working in English, written and spoken


Helpful, not required

  • Steam specifically: Steamworks, builds and depots, the store page, review and submission, and how Early Access behaves through the whole run

  • Live operations and a patch cadence

  • Working with external production partners before, on either side of the relationship

  • Time at a small studio where you were the only producer, or where the producer and product owner were the same person

  • A remote-first team


What we offer

The whole project and the authority that comes with it. Real decisions, not just a schedule to report against. Strong leads beside you rather than under you, and a Creative Director who wants to hand things over and means it. A company small enough that what you do is visible in what we ship, and people who will notice.

We are a self-motivated team, remote by choice and flexible in how we work, and we run on people helping each other rather than watching each other. Everyone here is trusted to own their part and supported when they need a hand, and we would like that to be true for you from your first week.

And we are early. Scape is heading to Steam with everything still ahead of it. Joining now means building something with a real chance of becoming big, and being one of the people it belongs to when it does.


Practical

  • Remote. Our working day runs on CET and this role keeps it.

  • Full time, on a long-term contract.

  • Start: as soon as you can. Tell us your notice period in the application form and we will work around it.

  • Recruitment is ongoing.

jobs.title: Principal Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Wir suchen eine:n Principal Platform Engineer (m/w/d) für den Aufbau und Betrieb unserer Data Platform – der Infrastruktur für Datenaufnahme, Speicherung und Laufzeitumgebungen, auf der alle Datenpipelines bei Shopware laufen. Du verantwortest ihre Architektur und Zuverlässigkeit: von der CDC-Datenaufnahme über einen dreistufigen Data Lake bis hin zur Orchestrierungsplattform.

Deine Arbeit ermöglicht es den Service-Teams und dem Management, unsere Kund:innen und Produkte besser zu verstehen. Zugleich schaffst du die technische Grundlage, um Anforderungen an Data Governance und Compliance tatsächlich durchzusetzen.

Du arbeitest eng mit Data & AI zusammen, die auf der von dir betriebenen Plattform Datenpipelines entwickelt. Im Service Enablement Team sorgst du dafür, dass für die Data Platform dieselben Golden Paths und Qualitätsstandards gelten wie für die übrige Service Platform. Die Position ist eine erfahrene Fachlaufbahn ohne Personalverantwortung. Wichtig ist, dass du gern mit vielen Stakeholdern, Kolleg:innen und Partnern zusammenarbeitest.


  • Datenaufnahme: CDC-Ingestion über DMS/Lambda in den Raw-Bereich von S3 sowie Verantwortung für Raw-Schema und Datenverträge. Derzeit umfasst die Plattform 13 Domänen und rund 180 Schemata über drei Ebenen hinweg. 11 CDC-Quellen laufen bereits produktiv, weitere kommen hinzu.

  • Speicherung und Orchestrierung: Verantwortung für die mit Terraform bereitgestellte Orchestrierungsplattform auf Basis von Step Functions, EventBridge und Glue über alle drei Lake-Ebenen (Raw, Curated und Aggregated) sowie für die zugehörigen CDC-Terraform-Module.

  • Datenkatalog-Infrastruktur: Betrieb und Bereitstellung von OpenMetadata. Dazu gehören die Katalog-Infrastruktur und die Trennung zwischen Betrieb und Nutzung wie bei den Lake-Ebenen. Data & AI ergänzt darauf aufbauend Datensatzbeschreibungen, Glossar und Stewardship-Inhalte.

  • Tooling-Infrastruktur: Bereitstellung und Betrieb von Superset, dem Werkzeug der Teams für Datenabfragen und Visualisierungen.

  • Abgrenzung der Pipelines: klare Codegrenzen, ein Merge-blockierender Vertragscheck und eine eindeutige Regel für die Weiterleitung von Vorfällen: Bei Infrastrukturproblemen wirst du benachrichtigt oder alarmiert, nicht bei Fehlern in der Pipeline-Logik.

  • Zuverlässigkeit: Aufbau von Observability und operativer Exzellenz für die Data Platform, unter anderem mit Datadog, Incident Response sowie SLOs und SLIs. Du übernimmst den On-Call-Dienst; die Vergütung dafür entspricht vom ersten Tag an der Regelung anderer Teams.

  • Governance- und Compliance-Mechanismen: Die Richtlinien selbst – etwa Klassifizierungsstandards, Aufbewahrungsregeln und der Umgang mit DSGVO- und Datenschutzanfragen – werden außerhalb von SET und Data & AI durch Legal/Compliance oder eine datenschutznahe Funktion verantwortet. Du legst diese Richtlinien nicht fest, sondern implementierst die dafür erforderliche Architektur: Aufbewahrungsfristen, Zugriffskontrollen, Klassifizierungsmetadaten und die Weiterleitung von Löschanfragen.

  • Plattformübergreifende Konsistenz: Zusammenarbeit mit dem Principal Platform Engineer für Infrastruktur, damit die Data Platform dieselbe Self-Service-Philosophie und denselben Reifegrad wie die übrige Plattform erreicht.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte praktische AWS-Erfahrung mit Glue, Athena, Step Functions, EventBridge, Lake Formation und S3 sowie umfassende Terraform-Erfahrung beim Erstellen und Weiterentwickeln gemeinsam genutzter Module.

  • Praxiserfahrung mit CDC-Pipelines und einer Iceberg-basierten Lakehouse-Architektur mit den Ebenen Raw, Curated und Aggregated. Dieses Format ist heute produktiv im Einsatz.

  • Vertrautheit mit Kafka-basiertem Event-Streaming (MSK, Glue Schema Registry) für Ereignisse auf Anwendungsebene, die neben CDC-Daten in der Plattform landen.

  • Sicherheit im Betrieb einer Plattform, auf die andere Teams angewiesen sind: Erfahrung mit Incident Response und SLOs sowie das Urteilsvermögen, individuelle Anforderungen in den Backlog aufzunehmen, statt sie ad hoc umzusetzen.

  • Starke teamübergreifende Kommunikation: Du arbeitest direkt mit Data & AI daran, die Grenzen zwischen Infrastruktur und Pipeline-Logik klar zu halten, und stimmst dich mit dem Principal Platform Engineer für Infrastruktur zu übergreifenden Standards ab. Keine der beiden Beziehungen ist eine Berichtslinie.

  • Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis dafür, was eine datengetriebene Kultur nachhaltig verankert: Führungskräfte, die anhand von Kennzahlen handeln, organisationsweite Datenkompetenz, eine für alle Zielgruppen zugängliche Infrastruktur und Daten als gemeinschaftliche Ressource.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher gegenüber der Führungsebene und sprichst Zielkonflikte und Risiken proaktiv an, statt darauf zu warten, danach gefragt zu werden.

  • Du kommunizierst schriftlich klar und direkt und kannst technische Positionen gegenüber Engineering-Kolleg:innen ebenso wie gegenüber nichttechnischen Stakeholdern vertreten und begründen.

Nice to have:

  • Vertrautheit mit dbt (dbt-athena) oder Spark/pySpark – genug, um konstruktiv darüber zu sprechen, wo die Grenze zwischen Infrastruktur und Pipeline-Logik künftig verlaufen sollte.

  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau eines On-Call-Dienstes für ein Team, das bisher noch keinen hatte.

  • Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Legal- und Compliance-Stakeholdern: Anforderungen an Aufbewahrungsfristen oder Datenklassifizierung in konkrete Infrastrukturentscheidungen übersetzen – und nicht nur wissen, dass es solche Anforderungen gibt.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!
Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Yanina Schröer und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!
